note: Universal gate. Runs on EVERY complaint and EVERY patient message, before and during intake. 'sense' is the plain-language question the model answers yes/no. The decision to escalate is made in code, never by the model. Set reviewed_by before any real patient uses this system.

levels.emergency: Stop intake immediately. Escalate. No further questions, no booking.
levels.urgent: Continue intake, but mark the history urgent and steer routing.

flags.sense: severe, crushing, or pressure-like chest pain, or chest pain spreading to the arm, jaw, neck, or back
fainting or collapse that happened during exertion, or together with chest pain or palpitations
severe difficulty breathing, or breathless while sitting still
too breathless to finish a full sentence
lips, tongue, or face turning blue or grey
choking, or something may have been swallowed or inhaled into the airway
coughing up blood in quantity -- more than streaks or specks; for example filling a tissue or a cup, or repeated mouthfuls of bright red blood
streaks or specks of blood in the phlegm, or a small amount of blood when coughing
sudden face drooping, sudden weakness or numbness on one side, or sudden difficulty speaking or understanding speech
a sudden, severe headache that reached its worst within seconds or minutes, or the worst headache of their life
a seizure or fit, especially a first one or one that will not stop
sudden loss of vision in one or both eyes
fever together with a stiff neck, dislike of bright light, or a rash that does not fade when pressed
new confusion, extreme drowsiness, difficulty waking, or unresponsiveness
swelling of the lips, tongue, or throat, or a tight throat
a widespread rash or hives together with breathing difficulty, dizziness, or vomiting after a food, sting, or medicine
heavy bleeding that will not stop
vomiting blood, or passing black tarry stools
passing a large amount of fresh blood from the back passage
fever with shaking chills, mottled or very pale skin, and looking or feeling extremely unwell
a fever in someone on chemotherapy, taking immune-suppressing medicine, or without a spleen
sudden severe abdominal pain, or an abdomen that is rigid and tender to touch
sudden severe pain or swelling in a testicle
pregnant, or possibly pregnant, with vaginal bleeding or severe abdominal pain
pregnant with a severe headache, visual disturbance, upper abdominal pain, or sudden swelling of the face and hands
pregnant and the baby is moving less than usual or not at all
thoughts of ending their life, a plan to do so, or having already acted on it
intent to seriously harm someone else
a head injury followed by vomiting, drowsiness, confusion, or fluid from the nose or ear
a suspected overdose, poisoning, or swallowing something harmful
burns to the face, or breathing in smoke or hot gases
a baby under three months old with a fever
losing weight without trying
drenching night sweats that soak the bedclothes
a cough lasting longer than three weeks
breathlessness that has been getting steadily worse over weeks
a new lump anywhere, or a mole that has changed
blood in the urine
a lasting change in bowel habit for more than three weeks
vaginal bleeding after the menopause
